articles.title: Bitcoin, ether little-changed despite record stocks, falling oil and easing war fears
articles.snippet: Global stocks hit records and oil cracked on a tentative US-Iran ceasefire extension. Crypto stayed on the sidelines, with some analysts saying the next catalyst is regulatory, not geopolitical.

articles.title: Solana open interest drops 30% as altcoins slump: Is $68 SOL next?
articles.snippet: Bulls abandon ship as SOL futures open interest dropped 30% in May. With the price weakening near $80, Solana may be destined for new lows.

articles.title: AI Agents Are Learning to Predict What Users Want—Before They Ask for It
articles.snippet: Researchers in China built a model that uses an AI’s downtime to prepare for users’ next question before they ask it.

articles.title: Bitcoin Traders Increasingly Convinced Price Will Fall Below $70K by End of May
articles.snippet: Prediction market odds are rising for Bitcoin to drop below $70,000 in the next few days following a dip to a six-week low price.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Crypto Majors Slide on Iran Escalations, ETF Outflows
articles.snippet: Massive ETF outflows just sent crypto sharply lower. Jefferies says the next crypto IPO wave could create a $1T public market.
